title: Pin the split in the contract bundle: the table enumeration and the substrate enum
notes:
2026-09-11 20:08 - Scope addition from 5eq: the derived TIER should become a field of the pinned Provenance object. It is carried durably today on the dispatch marker (dispatch.go:72,83,109) and implied by the tier-resolved profile digest, but internal/runstate/records.go Provenance has no tier field, so an over-tiered run still cannot be audited from provenance alone. That needs the same upstream bundle bump this tick already owns.
2026-09-12 14:07 - Third scope addition, from 7vn: the typed findings list should become a first-class bundle-pinned field of the role-result envelope rather than riding in the open result payload. 7vn's RESULT spells out the exact upstream delta, ready to file. This tick now carries three upstream bundle items: the runners-config table enumeration and substrate enum (its own), the tier in Provenance (from 5eq), and the findings channel (from 7vn).
